interpretation.calibration: Conditional uniform energy-density scale from bovine small-amplitude bulk response; unchanged within seed across interventions.
interpretation.units: Stress Pa; energy/work density J/m^3 conditional on the bulk calibration. No physical fracture area or Gc is identified.
interpretation.censoring: Maximum observed stress at the cap is not a resolved fracture peak; work through cap is not toughness.
interpretation.stability: Only three selected fine-grid states checked. Marginal means no resolved negative mode at that precision, not proof of stability; no claim of stability along the whole trajectory.
interpretation.strict_tier: Both resolutions complete, calibration/force/energy gates pass, maximum stress and cap-work step differences<=5%, and all three fine selected states positive.
interpretation.conditional_tier: Same gates, permitting marginal selected-state classifications; remains an explicitly conditional result, not a stability proof.
interpretation.fracture_tier: Additionally requires resolved uncensored peaks at both resolutions and <=5% work-to-peak step difference.
interpretation.statistics: Within-seed angle contrasts averaged first; primary group means require both prespecified planes for a seed. Four synthetic seeds; no biological p-values or independent-angle confidence intervals.
interpretation.damage_precision: No damage-fraction precision tolerance was prespecified. Generic numerical qualification is not a damage-precision gate; damage-ranking aggregates require direction agreement at both resolutions.
